name: influencer.edit
description: Changes a person's name, category (null for none), status (active, prospect or past) or notes; a field left out stays. Every member of the person's company may. Answers the fields as stored.
sql:
update brandbase.influencers i set
  name = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'name' then btrim(:name::text) else i.name end,
  category = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'category' then :category::text else i.category end,
  status = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'status' then :status::text else i.status end,
  notes = case when :fields::jsonb ? 'notes' then :notes::text else i.notes end,
  updated_at = :now::timestamptz
where i.id = :id::uuid
returning jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'name', i.name, 'category', i.category, 'status', i.status, 'notes', i.notes, 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(i.updated_at)) as result
